context: Sho-young plays soccer with friends; tells Ren about defeats.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 蓮にいちゃん、今日、負けた。
lines.style: Quiet, downturned opening. The sadness of a child who tried hard. Soft, almost whispered. Seeking reassurance but not asking for it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Gentle, unhurried response. Lean in slightly. Acknowledge the feeling without rushing past it. Warm, steady presence—the reliable older brother.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: But I was trying so hard!
lines.style: Small spike of frustration on the opening. The bewilderment of effort not paying off. Hurt underneath, not quite anger. Voice cracks slightly with disappointment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 草の上、皆と頑張ったんでしょ?
lines.en: You and everyone out there gave it everything, though, right?
lines.style: Warm, grounding redirection. Not dismissing the loss—reframing it. Steady, encouraging tone. Light emphasis on 「みんな」to remind him he wasn't alone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 帽子、飛んじゃった、走るとき。
lines.en: My hat flew off when I was running.
lines.style: Shift to quieter wonder—a small memory surfacing. Slight awe in the voice, momentary distraction from the loss. Soft, almost dreamy quality to the trailing thought.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 応援、皆で集めたら、強いはず。
lines.en: If everyone cheers for you next time, that strength will show.
lines.style: Gentle certainty. Not a promise, but a quiet truth. Lean back slightly—giving him space. Warm, tender inflection. The kind of thing an older brother says when he means it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yeah… next time, I'm going to win!
lines.style: Small breath of determination on the opening. Soft but resolute. Voice lifts slightly—hope restoring itself. The quiet conviction of a child who's been reminded he's not alone.
